products.title: Blood Bowl Spring Break! - 13 March 2027
products.body_html:
The annual Spring Break Blood Bowl tournament is taking place at a new theme park filled with dinosaurs. What could go wrong?

Welcome to Spring Break

BriBBe, the largest all-comers Blood Bowl league in Sussex, is pleased to host the 4th annual Spring Break Tournament. Designed as an ideal jumping on point for people new to competitive Blood Bowl and a chance for experienced players to have some fun rolling dice with wild builds, Spring Break focuses on thematic rules and simple rosters. There's plenty of participation prizes and a chance to show off your conversion skills with the unique star players as well.

Spring Break 2027 is part of the South East Tournament Series, a year-long collection of events covering Hampshire, Sussex, Kent and Surrey. If you play in at least 3 tournaments you will be able to compete for top place and a chance to represent the region in a team competition against the rest of England. For more details check out the series Website.

We'd love to welcome players from any and all leagues and playing groups. So there's only one thing for it: grab a ticket, choose a faction, enrol your star and join the party!

Full Rules 

Tourplay Registration

 

The Team

products.title: Purge of the Sector Tenebris – Legions Imperialis Narrative Event, 05 December 2026
products.body_html:
The Siege of Terra is over. Traitor forces are retreating, but they remain a significant threat, and the Loyalists are in pursuit. Sector Tenebris was cut off by the Ruinstorm for a long time, but it is now an important transit point for traitor forces retreating after the Siege. It’s heavily fortified and shielded, and can be held for a long time. The local traitor warlord has decided to hold it against the pursuing Loyalists, hoping to blunt their strength and speed and form a rally point for his own forces passing through the sector. Can the Loyalists break the fortified ring around the city districts and seize the space port, or will the traitors hold it and claim victory?

The day will consist of 2 battles — a 3,000 point initial battle and a 2.5 point city fight. Special assignments for each army. Players are encouraged to bring more thematic armies rather than “tournament style” ones.

 

If you've got any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at events@dicesaloon.com, or ask general queries in our Dice Saloon discord channel.

products.title: Destructive Duos 2: The Finale—a Warhammer: The Old World 2v2 Event, 17th October 2026
products.body_html:
Dice too heavy? Need a nap midgame? Sick of losing to your friend? Well, team up with
them and let them carry you to glory at Destructive Duos: The Finale, the conclusion to
the three-part series of 2v2 Warhammer: The Old World events! Across two games,
explore 2v2 scenarios and play double the amount of people, all whilst having a
convenient person to blame for any strategic mishaps!


All you will need is a (preferably willing) partner, two allied 1000 point armies (including
a baggage train) selected using the rules in the Warhammer: The Old World Matched
Play Guide (pages 36–37) and the usual accoutrements of gaming.


If you’re new to the Old World, this is an ideal event to get involved with the game by pairing with another player: twice the players, half the responsibility!


This event is the last in a series of three events that have taken place across 2026,
each consisting of 2 games. Players will earn points towards generalship, hobbying,
best narrative alliance, and sportsmanship at each event and the player with the highest
cumulative scores in each category at the end of the third event will receive a trophy!


Warning: the Winds of Magic are blowing particularly strongly around 88 London Road,
with all of the new magic rules in effect: Channeling, Arcane Magic, Arcane Ruses, and
Disastrous Miscasts.

  •  For more details on composition restrictions and scenarios please review the
    attached event precis.
  • Muster lists should be sent to oldworldbrighton@gmail.com no later than 23:59
    on the 9 th October.
  • If you want to ally two factions that the rules do not allow, but you can make a
    convincing narrative case for why it should be allowed, let us know and we’ll
    consider it.
  • If you want to join in but do not have a partner, check out the Old World channel
    on the Dice Saloon Discord, where others might be looking for partners for this
    event. Otherwise, let us know at oldworldbrighton@gmail.com and we’ll try to pair
    you up with another player.

 

The event pack for this event is available below:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DJUvP4XgVNMcFdBzwm1FPS8I_osVtbMh/view?usp=sharing

products.title: Star Wars: Legion Casual Gaming Day - 21 November 2026
products.body_html:
Deploy the garrison!

Join us for a day of casual Legion gaming at Dice Saloon. We’ll play three rounds of fun games with the emphasis on playing for the joy of the game rather than to win. It’ll be like game night, but during the day. A tournament, but more relaxed.

We’ll be playing to 1000 points and the usual list building rules. But the relaxed vibes means lists won’t be locked and you can tweak your army between games. Also, if your opponent agrees, adjust the terrain to suit your matchup, or choose missions instead of drawing cards… it’s all fine.

Doors open at 10am, with the first round starting at 10:30. We’ll finish by 7pm and be home in time for tea and biscuits.

About Dice Saloon

The Dice Saloon is Brighton’s biggest game store, with over 2000 sq ft of space dedicated to all forms of tabletop games, board games, card games, war games, role-playing games & more. Catering to both the casual and competitive player, Dice Saloon is committed to facilitating gamers needs both online and offline by providing all of the games and accessories you need at competitive prices, while also providing a high-quality event centre to play them in.

Food and Drink

Dice Saloon’s café carries a range of drinks, snacks, sandwiches and other refreshments. We ask that no outside food and drink be brought into the building. Any dietary requirements? Please inform us and we can make exceptions.

Transport

Brighton Train station is very well serviced from London Victoria and Clapham Junction - Dice Saloon is 7 Mins walk from the rear exit of the station.

The nearest bus stop is Preston Circus (Stop H) or York Hill (Stop D) serviced by the following routes: 5, 5A, 5B, 55 and others.

Parking

There is plenty of parking spaces nearby (though at a cost). The London Road car park is a 2-minute walk away at reasonable prices.

products.title: 40K Crusade - Beginner Friendly! - October 19, 2026
products.body_html:
Greetings curious new generals and experienced commanders alike. You are cordially invited to a beginner friendly Crusade event. Using the revamped 10th edition Crusade system, you will have the opportunity to slowly develop your troops from a fledgling force of 800 points to a mighty force of grizzled and experienced soldiers.

Crusade events are similar to our Path to Glory events for Age of Sigmar, a fantastic on ramp for learning the game and taking the experience learned here to larger games with others. Run by friendly community members, they will help you find an opponent on arrival and or be available to teach the game from a the ground level.

What this event requires from you:

A collection of assembled miniatures to represent an 1000 point 40k 10th ed army. Combat Patrols are a great start as these should be just right or very close to it. Painted minis are encouraged but not required. Your starting force should consist of one hero to be your warlord and one battle line unit at minimum. The other choices are up to you within the 1000 point limit. Named or unique units are not permitted.

Have access to your faction Index

Ten to twenty six sided dice

A tape measure marked in inches

A pad of paper and a writing implement of choice

These items are an excellent starting point but by no means exhaustive.

The event will take place between 1800 - 2200 on Monday's and will be occurring every fortnight. Individual battles are likely to take upwards of two hours depending on familiarity. If there are any questions then please speak up on the Crusade Dice Saloon Discord channel.

Discord Link

products.title: Dungeons & Dragons Beginner Session -The House That Ate Halloween, 31st October 2026
products.body_html:
D&D Beginner Sessions at Dice Saloon!

This session is for persons aged 16yrs and above

Have you always wanted to play Dungeons & Dragons but never had the right opportunity? Or perhaps you’ve been curious, but found the whole thing a little intimidating?

Worry no more, because at Dice Saloon, we are introducing D&D sessions for beginners! Even if you’ve never so much as held a set of polyhedral dice, you are welcome to test the waters of adventure and glory in our one-shot games for groups of up to 6 players.As a note, we do require at least 2 attendees for the event to go ahead - if unfortunately no other tickets are sold, you will be contacted and refunded. 

These single sessions will last approximately 3 hours, during which players will each be given a pre-made character and a run-down of the basics, before your Dungeon Master guides you on your journey through a dangerous and exciting fantasy world!

The House That Ate Halloween

A Halloween Dungeons & Dragons one-shot

You are cordially invited to a grand feast at a mysterious manor. Your host is charming, the food is exquisite, and the evening promises to be unforgettable.

Then the front door disappears.

Corridors twist, something scratches behind the wallpaper, and the servants seem desperate to tell you something. As the house reveals its sinister appetite, you’ll need to uncover its secrets, navigate impossible rooms, and work together to survive until dawn.

Step inside for an evening of haunted-house horror, dark humour, eerie puzzles, and monstrous encounters. Will you escape—or become part of the house forever?

products.title: Arkham Horror Card Game Children of Blood Campaign - Blood Money 31/10
products.body_html:
Welcome investigators to the Children of Blood mini-campaign!

Sun sets on the city of Arkham. Citizens hurry home in the growing twilight, eager to find safety behind locked doors. Arkham has always played host to strange occurrences, but this time, something is different. Police respond to reports of disturbances, finding spilled blood and torn clothes but no sign of the culprits or victims. As reports pile up with each passing week, one thing is abundantly clear: something is stalking the streets after nightfall. Something dangerous.

You will need: 

  • TWO legal investigator decks built to the specified XP level. Ideally one that has the ability to gain clues easily and regularly or one that can handle themselves against monsters, then your second deck can be whatever you like. The XP level will be updated based on the previous scenarios and shown in the campaign log (google doc link at bottom of page) If you own the scenario it would also be very helpful to bring that. We recommend each player bring an additional deck in the unlikely event we need to 'balance' the groups a little better. 

  • A copy of the scenario. This is not important but we only have access to a couple of copies so extras will always be required. Please do not be offended if yours isn't used. (It's better we have extras than not enough!) 

  • A set of tokens and chaos bag along with keys, blessed and cursed chaos counters. Again this not important but we will only have access to limited sets.

We will be playing on Standard difficulty.

There is no need to commit to every scenario during this campaign you can drop in and out for any scenario, abiding by the rules currently set by the campaign log.

In this campaign we will be insisting that your investigator deck will be built with a total experience no more then 3 below the maximum available. This is to ensure that the power level of your deck is adequate for the point we are at in the campaign.

products.body_html:
Friday night is Blood Bowl night and now it’s time to hit the pitch!


These sessions will offer the following game formats for organised games for veterans as well as tutorial games for newer players:


Blood Bowl Sevens - this played on a smaller pitch with only 7 players rather than the standard 11 players. Sevens is the equivalent of college football in America with players being less well drilled and skilled than the big leagues of standard Blood Bowl.


Standard Blood Bowl (Elevens) -  in a ladder competition for those players that aren't able to, or would prefer not to commit to the main league.


Gutterbowl - this is the less officially recognised and definitely under the radar form of Blood Bowl that is played by opposing taverns in the market squares cities across the old world. Occasionally it will be played in the sewers of the larger cities to avoid the authorities.


Dungeon Bowl - run by the nerds at the Colleges of Magic, as it name suggests this isn’t played on a pitch but in a dungeon with teleporters and exploding chests (one of them contains a ball). Each college of magic sponsors it’s own team drawing on a mixture of races rather than the traditional (mostly) single race teams found in standard Blood Bowl.

And a discord server here

As well as the general Dice Saloon Server here


BriBBe also runs a league with one match played every 2 weeks, with an 8 match season before playoffs.

The House That Ate Halloween

A Halloween Dungeons & Dragons one-shot

You are cordially invited to a grand feast at a mysterious manor. Your host is charming, the food is exquisite, and the evening promises to be unforgettable.

Then the front door disappears.

Corridors twist, something scratches behind the wallpaper, and the servants seem desperate to tell you something. As the house reveals its sinister appetite, you’ll need to uncover its secrets, navigate impossible rooms, and work together to survive until dawn.

Step inside for an evening of haunted-house horror, dark humour, eerie puzzles, and monstrous encounters. Will you escape—or become part of the house forever?
